summary: Straight-line initializer that resets the buffer state fields of the caller's object. Writes 0 to the dword fields at offsets 0x400, 0x404 and 0x408, then writes the constant 500 to the field at offset 0x40C. Returns 0 unconditionally. Called by BufferedCharIOInit (0x005876F0) and sub_5878A0 (0x005878A0) as the constant-seeding part of a buffer-state reset.
